facts.fact: Rwanda took part in the EAC's November 2025 technical meeting in Kigali on the EAC Cross-Border Payment System Masterplan and its first pilot, linking RSwitch with Tanzania's TIPS.
A technical meeting under the EAC Cross-Border Payment System Masterplan, held 10-14 November 2025 in Kigali, was chaired by Fabian Ladislaus Kasole of the Bank of Tanzania, according to the EAC.

The EAC describes Rwanda National Payment Switch (RSwitch) as the country's national retail payment switch, to be linked with the partner switch to move money between bank accounts and mobile money wallets.

The EAC describes Tanzania Instant Payment System (TIPS) as the country's national retail payment switch, to be linked with the partner switch to move money between bank accounts and mobile money wallets.
